tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background and the default surface. Also the text colour on teal and navy (7.0:1 and 9.5:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Section bands and the large angled side panels. Navy text on it is 7.0:1, teal text 5.1:1.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Second, lighter panel layer that overlaps sage, and the dashed stitch lines on cream.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Decoration only: ray bursts, exclamation marks, the lightbulb, keycap letters on steel. Never text on cream or sage.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Wordmark letters, keycap tops, pixel clusters, display type and the hero slogan at 24px and up on cream (3.9:1, so never small text).

tokens.name: teal-mid
tokens.usage: Lighter side face of a keycap. Shading only.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Plaques, dark bands, darker keycap face, secondary text on cream (7.0:1) and on sage (5.1:1).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Body text on cream, sage and sage-soft (9.5:1 on cream). The S of the wordmark, the beaver's cap, star bursts, focus ring.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Beaver body. Mascot only, never UI.

tokens.name: bark-deep
tokens.usage: Beaver ears, eyes, nose and mouth. Mascot only.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Beaver teeth. May appear as one tiny warm accent per screen at most; never text.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline. Steel or navy on cream, cream on teal.

styles.name: display-card
styles.usage: Card titles. Navy or teal; steel only at this size or larger.

styles.name: label-plaque
styles.usage: Tagline and plaque text: cream on teal.

styles.name: label-tag
styles.usage: Tags, dates, small labels. Navy or teal on light grounds, cream on teal.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy. Navy on cream, sage or sage-soft; cream on teal.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Captions and footer text. Teal on cream, navy on sage.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag and its neighbour; pixel-cluster square gap is half this.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; padding inside tags and buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Header height; vertical padding of a section on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop.

tokens.name: layer-offset
tokens.usage: How far the flat second paper layer sits down and right of a card, button or plaque. The layer is a solid colour, never a blurred shadow.

tokens.name: radius-cut
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons and plaques have no radius: their outline is a cut polygon from the cut tokens.

tokens.name: radius-soft
tokens.usage: Only inside illustrations (beaver nose, teeth) and for the focus ring on round elements.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: The round badge logo and avatars, always with a stitch ring inside.

cut.note: Hand-cut outlines as clip-path values. Every card, button and plaque takes one, so no two neighbours share the same outline.

tokens.name: cut-a
tokens.usage: Cards and buttons, first variant.

tokens.name: cut-b
tokens.usage: Cards and buttons, second variant; alternate with cut-a.

tokens.name: cut-c
tokens.usage: Cards and buttons, third variant.

tokens.name: cut-plaque
tokens.usage: The jagged tagline plaque. Teal fill, cream label-plaque text.

stitch.note: The dashed stitch line that edges the banner and rings the badge.

tokens.name: stitch-dash
tokens.usage: Length of one dash.

tokens.name: stitch-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between dashes.

tokens.name: stitch-weight
tokens.usage: Thickness of a dash. Dash ends are slightly rounded.

tokens.name: stitch-row-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the two rows. Stitch lines always come as a pair.
